newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi meets hard left's Bertinotti.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi meets hard left's Bertinotti.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi held an hour of talks on Friday with his communist ally Fausto Bertinotti, political sources said.
They gave no details of the talks at Prodi's office, which followed strains over Bertinotti's opposition to Italian plans to lead a multinational security force to Albania.
Bertinotti's Communist Refoundation party is not in the government but ensures its majority in the lower house of parliament.
Differences over the force have caused tensions in the coalition but Prodi's supporters and Bertinotti have said the issue will not bring down the government.
